item: How long a legacy net-metering customer keeps the tariff
source_title: CPUC — Net Energy Metering and Net Billing
evidence: 'Pursuant to D.14-03-041, customer-generators are allowed to remain on the NEM 2.0 tariff for 20 years from the date they interconnected, or they are permitted to switch to the current tariff.' NEM tariffs are closed to new enrolment.

value: Net billing tariff: exports credited at avoided-cost values, usually below the retail rate
source_title: CPUC — Net Energy Metering and Net Billing
evidence: 'Since April 15, 2023, customers applying for interconnection have taken service on the new net billing tariff... The value of the export compensation ... is usually lower than the retail rate'.

item: Interconnection date of the Cupertino system
evidence: Not supplied. It decides the year the present credit ends: a system connected in 2016 keeps the tariff to 2036, one connected in early 2023 to 2043.
